  --text:#1d1d1f; --text-2:#6e6e73; --text-3:#a1a1a6;
  --accent:#0071e3; --accent-h:#0077ed; --accent-soft:rgba(0,113,227,.09);
  --success:#34c759; --warning:#ff9f0a; --danger:#ff3b30;
  --r-sm:8px; --r-md:12px; --r-lg:18px; --r-pill:980px;
  --sh-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04),0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  --sh-md:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.07),0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --font:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','SF Pro Text','Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-size:14px;line-height:1.47;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;border-radius:0;overflow:hidden;
}
#app *,#app *::before,#app *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
#app .view{display:none}
#app .view.active{display:block;animation:npu-fade .25s ease}
@keyframes npu-fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#app .nav{background:rgba(251,251,253,.8);backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:56px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}
#app .nav-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--text)}
#app .nav-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.045);padding:3px;border-radius:var(--r-pill)}
#app .nav-tab{padding:6px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:none;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-2);cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s,background .2s,box-shadow .2s}
#app .nav-tab:hover{color:var(--text)}
#app .nav-tab.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
#app .nav-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
#app .content{flex:1;padding:36px 28px;max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
#app .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:none;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
#app .btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
#app .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-h);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,113,227,.32)}
#app .btn-secondary{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-2)}
#app .btn-secondary:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--text-3)}
#app .btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent)}
#app .btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--accent-soft)}
#app .btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
#app .btn-sm{padding:5px 13px;font-size:12px}
#app .card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);overflow:hidden}
#app .card-body{padding:22px 24px}
#app .kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(168px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:24px}
#app .kpi{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);padding:20px 22px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
#app .kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--sh-md)}
#app .kpi.clickable{cursor:pointer}
#app .kpi.clickable:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent),var(--sh-md)}
#app .kpi-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:10px}
#app .kpi-value{font-size:34px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
#app .kpi-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:8px}
#app .kpi.accent .kpi-value{color:var(--accent)}
#app .kpi.success .kpi-value{color:var(--success)}
#app .kpi.warning .kpi-value{color:var(--warning)}
#app .version-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d1d1f 0%,#3a3a3c 100%);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:24px 28px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:24px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
#app .version-label{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#app .meta-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:14px 28px;margin-top:18px}
#app .meta-k{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.55;margin-bottom:3px}
#app .meta-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;word-break:break-word}
#app .sync-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;max-width:660px}
#app .sync-msg{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5}
#app .sync-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;animation:npu-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes npu-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.8)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
#app .sync-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-3)}
#app .tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto}
#app table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
#app th{padding:12px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap}
#app th.sortable{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;transition:color .15s}
#app th.sortable:hover{color:var(--accent)}
#app td{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle}
#app tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
#app tbody tr{transition:background .15s}
#app tbody tr:hover td{background:var(--surface-2)}
#app .col-name{font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
#app .col-scope{font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2)}
#app .col-ver{font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
#app .col-ver .arrow{color:var(--text-3);margin:0 5px}
#app .col-ver .latest{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
#app .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:capitalize}
#app .pill::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
#app .pill-pending{background:rgba(110,110,115,.1);color:var(--text-2)}
#app .pill-running{background:rgba(255,159,10,.14);color:#bf7e00}
#app .pill-success,#app .pill-complete{background:rgba(52,199,89,.15);color:#1a8c37}
#app .pill-failed{background:rgba(255,59,48,.13);color:#d0021b}
#app .pill-queued,#app .pill-in_progress{background:rgba(0,113,227,.12);color:var(--accent)}
#app .pill-installing{background:rgba(255,159,10,.16);color:#bf7e00}
#app .prog-wrap{height:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.07);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px}
#app .prog-bar{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:3px;transition:width .5s ease}
#app .prog-bar.success{background:var(--success)}
#app .prog-bar.failed{background:var(--danger)}
#app .check{width:16px;height:16px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--accent)}
#app .wizard-steps{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:32px}
#app .wstep{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-3)}
#app .wstep.active{color:var(--accent)}
#app .wstep.done{color:var(--success)}
#app .wstep-num{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
#app .wstep.active .wstep-num{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
#app .wstep.done .wstep-num{background:var(--success);border-color:var(--success);color:#fff}
#app .wstep-divider{flex:1;height:2px;background:var(--border);margin:0 14px;border-radius:1px}
#app .section-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:20px}
#app .empty{text-align:center;padding:48px;color:var(--text-3);font-size:14px}
#app .filter-bar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
#app .search{padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);font:inherit;font-size:13px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);min-width:220px;outline:none;transition:border .15s,box-shadow .15s}
#app .search:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
#app select.search{min-width:200px}
#app .count-badge{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
#app .actions-bar{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
#app .info-box{background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:14px 18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.5}
#app .loading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--text-2);font-size:13px;padding:48px;justify-content:center}
@keyframes npu-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#app .spinner{width:20px;height:20px;border:2px solid var(--border-2);border-top-color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;animation:npu-spin .7s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0}
#app .guide-section h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
#app .guide-section p,#app .guide-section li{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.6}
#app .guide-section ul,#app .guide-section ol{padding-left:20px}
#app .guide-section li{margin-bottom:8px}
#app .guide-section code{font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;color:var(--text)}
#app .alert{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px}
#app .alert-danger{background:rgba(255,59,48,.08);color:#a51200}
#app .mt16{margin-top:16px}
#app .row-gap{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* --- Azioni del wizard, sopra la tabella (v1.4.0) --------------------------
   Con centinaia di applicazioni la tabella supera i 10.000px di altezza: i
   pulsanti vanno prima della lista, non dopo, così l'utente non deve scorrere
   nulla per procedere. */
#app .top-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
#app .top-actions .ta-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3)}
#app .top-actions .count-badge{margin-left:4px}

/* --- Rendering cap notice --- */
/* ---- Paginazione (v1.6.5) — Step 1, Step 2 e Monitor.
   Sostituisce il vecchio cap di rendering a 150 righe + "show all". ---- */
#app .npu-pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2)}
#app .npu-pager-info{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2)}
#app .npu-pager-size{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2)}
#app .npu-pager-size select{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);font:inherit;font-size:12px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);outline:none}
#app .npu-pager-size select:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
#app .npu-pager-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
#app .npu-pg{min-width:30px;height:30px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surface);font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s}
#app .npu-pg:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
#app .npu-pg:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
#app .npu-pg.current{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;cursor:default}
#app .npu-pg-gap{min-width:18px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);user-select:none}
/* KPI attivo come filtro (v1.6.5): lo stato va letto a colpo d'occhio, perche'
   una tabella filtrata senza indicazione visiva sembra una tabella incompleta. */
#app .kpi-active{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent),var(--sh-md)}
#app .kpi-active .kpi-label{color:var(--accent)}
#app .cap-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:center;padding:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);background:var(--surface-2);border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#app .link-btn{background:none;border:none;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;padding:0;text-decoration:underline}
#app .link-btn:hover{color:var(--accent-h)}

/* --- Status pill: icona oltre al colore (leggibilità senza distinguere i colori) --- */
#app .pill-cancelled{background:rgba(110,110,115,.12);color:var(--text-2)}
#app .pill-partial{background:rgba(255,159,10,.16);color:#bf7e00}
#app .pill .pico{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
#app .pill.has-ico::before{display:none}

/* --- Modal di conferma --- */
#app .modal-back{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.32);z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;animation:npu-fade .18s ease}
#app .npu-modal{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--sh-md);max-width:460px;width:100%;padding:26px 28px}
#app .npu-modal h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:10px}
#app .npu-modal p{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:8px}
#app .npu-modal .modal-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:22px}
#app .btn-danger{background:var(--danger);color:#fff}
#app .btn-danger:hover{background:#e0281e}

/* --- Riga espandibile con il motivo del fallimento ------------------------
   Il messaggio della piattaforma può essere lungo: comprimerlo in una colonna
   lo rende illeggibile. Sta invece in una riga di dettaglio a piena larghezza,
   aperta su richiesta solo per la riga che interessa. */
#app .why-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;
  width:auto;padding:3px 9px;border:none;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  background:rgba(255,59,48,.10);color:#c0281b;
  font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;
}
#app .why-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,59,48,.18)}
#app .why-btn .chev{font-size:9px;transition:transform .2s}
#app .why-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#app tr.why-row td{background:var(--surface-2);padding:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
#app .why-box{
  padding:14px 18px 16px;border-left:3px solid var(--danger);
  animation:npu-fade .18s ease;
}
#app .why-label{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--danger);margin-bottom:7px;
}
#app .why-msg{
  font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;
  color:var(--text);white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;
}
#app .why-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:8px}

/* --- Riepilogo di fine batch --- */
#app .summary{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-lg);margin-bottom:20px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
#app .summary-ok{background:rgba(52,199,89,.10)}
#app .summary-warn{background:rgba(255,159,10,.12)}
#app .summary-bad{background:rgba(255,59,48,.09)}
#app .summary-ico{font-size:22px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0}
#app .summary-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px}
#app .summary-text{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);line-height:1.5}

/* --- Progress bar dello store sync --- */
#app .sync-prog{max-width:660px;margin-top:10px}
#app .sync-phase{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:6px}

/* Screen-reader only: annunci di stato senza impatto visivo. */
#app .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

   Suite panel: one shared block, suite-only, shown identically above the
   table in both Step 1 and Step 2, expandable. Per-row tree: each table row
   that pulls in dependencies (per-app DependencyProcessor-style resolution,
   not the suite) gets its own "N more" expandable detail row — there is no
   heuristic tier, every listed app carries the same "will be updated"

#app .impact-panel-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
#app .impact-panel-title .accent-num{color:var(--accent)}
#app .impact-list{margin-top:12px;display:none}
#app .impact-list.open{display:block}
#app .impact-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,113,227,.12);font-size:12px}

#app .impact-name{font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}
#app .impact-ver{font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',monospace;color:var(--text-2);white-space:nowrap}
#app .badge-hidden{background:rgba(110,110,115,.12);color:var(--text-2);font-size:9px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);margin-left:6px;white-space:nowrap}
#app .tree-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:none;border:none;font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;padding:0}
#app .tree-btn .chev{font-size:8px;transition:transform .2s}
#app .tree-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#app tr.tree-row td{background:var(--surface-2);padding:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
#app .tree-box{padding:12px 18px 14px;animation:npu-fade .18s ease}
#app .tree-box .impact-row:first-child{border-top:none}
#app .confirm-union{margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#app .confirm-union-list{max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:10px}

      <div class="card" style="padding:24px 28px">
        <div class="guide-section">
          <h3>Overview</h3>
          <p>Now Plugin Updater lets a ServiceNow administrator discover, select, and install the available updates for Store applications on this instance from a single screen, replacing the per-app flow in the native Application Manager. It also shows the same dependency impact the native Application Manager surfaces — which other applications will update alongside the ones you pick — before you launch. You need the <code>admin</code> role to use it.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>1 · Home</h3>
          <p>Shows the instance name and release, its data center and database, the signed-in admin, and the last upgrade date, plus four app indicators that reconcile: <strong>Apps</strong> (total managed = up‑to‑date + updates available), <strong>Up to Date</strong>, <strong>Updates Available</strong>, and <strong>Installing</strong> (running right now). Use <strong>Start Wizard</strong> to begin, <strong>Refresh Data</strong> to reload, or <strong>Monitor installs</strong> to open the monitor. Clicking the <strong>Installing</strong> card opens the batch currently running.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>2 · Wizard — Discover</h3>
          <p>Lists every Store application with an available update (the same set the native Application Manager shows: active, visible, previously installed). Each row shows the scope and the current → latest version. Click any column header to sort ascending/descending.</p>
          <p>If any updatable apps belong to the same platform suite (for example <em>Now Assist</em>), a banner above the table names the suite and how many apps in it will update together — click <strong>Show apps</strong> to see the full list. Independently, any row that will pull in other applications — because it is a member of that suite, because installing it requires updating another app first, or both — shows a <strong>N more</strong> link next to its name; click it to expand exactly which applications and versions that row brings with it. This is the same information the native Application Manager shows in its own <em>Review Installation Details</em> dialog, surfaced here per row instead of one app at a time.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>3 · Wizard — Select</h3>
          <p>Filter by name, narrow by <strong>scope</strong>, tick the applications to update (or use <strong>Select All</strong>), then click <strong>Install</strong> and confirm. The buttons sit <strong>above the list</strong>, so you never have to scroll hundreds of rows to continue. Apps already being installed are shown as <em>installing</em> and cannot be re-selected.</p>
          <p>Very long lists render the first 150 rows for speed — use <strong>show all</strong> or the filters to reach the rest. <strong>Select All</strong> always applies to everything matching the current filter, not just the visible rows.</p>
          <p>The same suite banner and per-row <strong>N more</strong> links from Discover are shown here too, so the impact of a row stays visible while you're choosing what to install.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>4 · Confirm & Launch</h3>
          <p>Before anything installs, the confirmation dialog names the instance, lists the <strong>selected applications</strong> you are about to install (expand <strong>Show all</strong> on long lists), and separately shows how many <strong>additional</strong> applications will update as a result of those selections — a single deduplicated count, never a per-row sum, with its own <strong>Show all</strong> link. The two lists are kept apart on purpose: one is what you chose, the other is what the platform adds on its own. Review both, then confirm to launch.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>5 · Launch & Monitor</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Installs are triggered with <strong>your own admin session</strong> — no credentials are stored.</li>
            <li>They are enqueued <strong>one at a time</strong> (the platform's CICD install API is single-flight); a busy queue is retried automatically, and a 400 “offering required” error is retried with the offering id.</li>
            <li>Once launching finishes you can <strong>close the page</strong>: a scheduled job on the server tracks every install, verifies the installed version, and marks each <em>Complete</em> or <em>Failed</em>.</li>
            <li>An install counts as <strong>Complete</strong> only if the application actually reaches the target version. If the platform reports success but the version did not change, the row is marked <strong>Failed</strong> with the version it stayed on.</li>
            <li>Whenever a row carries a message, a <strong>Details</strong> (or <strong>Why failed</strong>) button appears in the last column. It opens the exact text reported by the platform underneath that row — useful for telling apart an app that was rejected at launch from one whose install did not apply. If any application fails to launch, the wizard stays on the Launch step so you can read the reasons before moving on.</li>
            <li>The <strong>Monitor</strong> tab shows the batch with five counters — Total, <strong>Installing</strong> (running right now), <strong>Queued</strong> (waiting in the server queue), Complete, Failed — and a sortable per-app table. When the batch ends a summary appears, with a shortcut to list only the failures.</li>
            <li>Underneath any application that pulled in dependencies, a <strong>dependency</strong> badge marks the applications the platform actually installed alongside it — this reflects what really happened, read directly from the platform's own installation tracker, not a prediction made before launch.</li>
            <li><strong>Cancel queued</strong> drops the applications still waiting in the queue. Installs already running cannot be interrupted and will finish.</li>
            <li>Reopening the page reloads your most recent batch automatically; the batch selector lets you review earlier ones.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>Notes</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Because the list mirrors the Application Manager, a few platform-bundled apps that cannot be updated via the Store API will end as <strong>Failed</strong> — this is expected.</li>
            <li>Keep the page open only for the few seconds of launching; installs and monitoring then continue on the server.</li>
            <li><strong>Sync with Store</strong> runs the same catalog check as the Application Manager and shows its real progress, then reloads the page when it finishes — typically a couple of minutes. If it is still running after five minutes the page stops following it and says so: the sync keeps going on the server and does not need this page open.</li>
            <li>Dependency impact is informational: the batch installs exactly what you selected — the platform pulls in the rest by itself once an install runs. Apps shown as impact but marked <em>not selectable</em> are hidden dependencies that update automatically and cannot be picked individually.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-section mt16">
          <h3>Access Control</h3>
          <p>This page, its data, and the install log are restricted to the <code>admin</code> role.</p>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var S = {
    info:{}, appData:{apps:[],inFlight:[],appsUpToDate:0},
    selected:{}, installRows:[], historyRows:[],
    version:'1.6.5',
    sessionId:'sess_'+(new Date().getTime()),
    pollTimers:{}, pollDeadlines:{},
    POLL_INTERVAL:15000, POLL_TIMEOUT:1800000, BATCH:8,
    // Paginazione (v1.6.5). Sostituisce il cap di rendering a 150 righe: il
    // paging era stato scartato temendo di spezzare la selezione multipla, ma
    // S.selected e' indicizzato per sysId e vive fuori dal rendering, quindi la
    // selezione attraversa le pagine senza perdersi. Pagina e page size sono
    // indipendenti per vista (w1 = Step 1, sel = Step 2, mon = Monitor).
    page:{w1:1,sel:1,mon:1},
    pageSize:{w1:25,sel:25,mon:25},
    PAGE_SIZES:[25,50,100,150,200],
    // Righe di dettaglio aperte, per chiave: sopravvive ai refresh del polling.
    whyOpen:{}, launchWhyOpen:{},
    // Filtro per status guidato dai KPI del Monitor (v1.6.5). Stringa vuota =
    // nessun filtro. Assorbe il precedente monOnlyFailed, che faceva la stessa
    // cosa per il solo stato 'failed' con uno stato separato da mantenere.
    monFilter:'',
    // Alberi di dipendenza per-riga aperti (v1.5.2, §6), per scope — separati
    // tra Step 1 e Step 2 così aprirne uno in una vista non apre l'altro.
    treeOpenW1:{}, treeOpenSel:{},
    loadedHome:false, appsFetchedAt:0
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s){ s=(s==null?'':''+s); return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
  function num(v){ return (v==null||v==='')?'—':v; }
  function plural(n,one,many){ return n+' '+(n===1?one:many); }

  // Garantisce che un callback venga eseguito una volta sola. Serve nel launch:
  // se un done() non venisse mai invocato la coda si fermerebbe in silenzio, se
  // venisse invocato due volte il contatore avanzerebbe di troppo.
  function once(fn){ var called=false; return function(){ if(called) return; called=true; fn(); }; }

  function debounce(fn, ms){
    var t=null;
    return function(){ if(t) clearTimeout(t); t=setTimeout(function(){ t=null; fn(); }, ms); };
  }

  // Pill di stato con icona oltre al colore: il colore da solo non è distinguibile
  // per chi ha una deficienza nella visione dei colori.
  var STATUS_ICO = { complete:'✓', failed:'✕', installing:'⟳', queued:'•', cancelled:'⊘', running:'⟳', partial:'!' };
  function statusPill(st){
    st=(st||'queued');
    var ico=STATUS_ICO[st]||'•';
    return '<span class="pill pill-'+esc(st)+' has-ico"><span class="pico" aria-hidden="true">'+ico+'</span>'+esc(st)+'</span>';
  }

  // ---- Modal di conferma (nessuna dipendenza esterna) ----
  function closeModal(){ var h=$('modal-host'); if(h){ h.innerHTML=''; } }
  function confirmModal(opts){
    var host=$('modal-host'); if(!host){ if(opts.onConfirm) opts.onConfirm(); return; }
    var danger = !!opts.danger;
    host.innerHTML=''
      + '<div class="modal-back" id="modal-back">'
      +   '<div class="npu-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-title">'
      +     '<h3 id="modal-title">'+esc(opts.title||'Confirm')+'</h3>'
      +     '<p>'+(opts.bodyHtml||esc(opts.body||''))+'</p>'
      +     '<div class="modal-btns">'
      +       '<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="modal-no">'+esc(opts.cancelLabel||'Cancel')+'</button>'
      +       '<button class="btn '+(danger?'btn-danger':'btn-primary')+'" id="modal-yes">'+esc(opts.confirmLabel||'Confirm')+'</button>'
      +     '</div>'
      +   '</div>'
      + '</div>';
    var yes=$('modal-yes'), no=$('modal-no'), back=$('modal-back');
    function bail(){ closeModal(); if(opts.onCancel) opts.onCancel(); }
    yes.onclick=function(){ closeModal(); if(opts.onConfirm) opts.onConfirm(); };
    no.onclick=bail;
    // Click sullo sfondo = annulla; Esc idem.
    back.onclick=function(e){ if(e.target===back) bail(); };
    host.onkeydown=function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape'||e.keyCode===27) bail(); };
    yes.focus();
  }

  function announce(msg){ var el=$('mon-live'); if(el){ el.textContent=msg; } }

  function ajax(method, params, cb){
    try {
      var ga=new GlideAjax('PluginUpdaterAjax');
      ga.addParam('sysparm_name',method);
      if(params){ for(var k in params){ ga.addParam('sysparm_'+k, params[k]); } }
      ga.getXMLAnswer(function(ans){
        if(ans==null||ans===''){ cb('Empty response from server', null); return; }
        try{ cb(null, JSON.parse(ans)); }catch(e){ cb('Parse error: '+e.message+' :: '+ans, null); }
      });
    } catch(e){ cb('GlideAjax unavailable: '+e.message, null); }
  }

  // ---- View switching ----
  function showView(v){
    var views=document.querySelectorAll('.view'), i;
    for(i=0;i<views.length;i++){ views[i].classList.toggle('active', views[i].getAttribute('data-view')===v); }
    var tabs=document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab');
    for(i=0;i<tabs.length;i++){
      var t=tabs[i].getAttribute('data-tab');
      tabs[i].classList.toggle('active', t===v || (t==='wizard' && v.indexOf('wizard')===0));
    }
  }


  // ---- HOME ----
  // Una sola chiamata (getHomeData) invece di due: meno round-trip e un solo
  // esito d'errore da gestire, invece di due parziali con il secondo scartato.
  function loadHome(){
    $('home-body').innerHTML='<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div> Loading instance data…</div>';
    ajax('getHomeData',{},function(e,d){
      if(e || !d){ S.info={}; S.appData=normalizeApps(null); renderHome(e||'No data returned'); return; }
      S.info=d.info||{};
      S.appData=normalizeApps(d.appData);
      S.appsFetchedAt=new Date().getTime();
      renderHome(d.infoError||d.appsError||'');
    });
  }

  function normalizeApps(d){
    d=d||{}; d.apps=d.apps||[]; d.inFlight=d.inFlight||[];
    if(d.appsUpToDate==null) d.appsUpToDate='—';
    return d;
  }

  function renderHome(err){
    var a=S.appData, info=S.info;
    var inProg=(info.installsRunning!=null?info.installsRunning:0);
    var avail=(a.apps?a.apps.length:0);
    var utd=parseInt(a.appsUpToDate,10); if(isNaN(utd)){ utd=0; }
    var storeTotal=utd+avail;
    var who=(window.g_user&&g_user.getFullName)?g_user.getFullName():'';
    function mrow(k,v){ return v?('<div class="meta-item"><div class="meta-k">'+k+'</div><div class="meta-v">'+esc(v)+'</div></div>'):''; }
    var grid=mrow('Release',info.versionLabel)+mrow('Data Center',info.dataCenter)+mrow('Database',info.dbType)
      + mrow('Signed in',who)+mrow('Last Upgraded',info.lastUpgraded)+mrow('Store Synced',info.lastStoreSync);
    var h=''
      + '<div class="version-banner">'
      +   '<div class="version-label">'+esc(info.instanceName||info.versionLabel||'ServiceNow')+'</div>'
      +   '<div class="meta-grid">'+grid+'</div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="kpi-grid">'
      +   kpi('Apps', storeTotal, 'managed (active & visible)','')
      +   kpi('Up to Date', num(a.appsUpToDate), 'no update available','success')
      +   kpi('Updates Available', avail, 'update pending', avail>0?'warning':'')
      +   '<div class="kpi'+(inProg>0?' accent clickable':'')+'" id="kpi-inprogress" title="'+(inProg>0?'Open the running batch':'')+'"><div class="kpi-label">Installing</div>'
      +     '<div class="kpi-value">'+esc(inProg)+'</div><div class="kpi-sub">'+(inProg>0?'running now • open monitor':'running now')+'</div></div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="row-gap">'
      +   '<button class="btn btn-primary" id="home-start"'+(avail>0?'':' disabled')+'>Start Wizard</button>'
      +   '<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="home-refresh">Refresh Data</button>'
      +   '<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="home-sync">Sync with Store</button>'
      +   '<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="home-monitor">Monitor installs</button>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div id="sync-status" style="margin-top:14px"></div>'
      + (err?'<div class="alert alert-danger mt16">'+esc(err)+'</div>':'')
      + '<div style="margin-top:28px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3)">Now Plugin Updater v'+S.version+' · by Gianmario Marongiu</div>';
    $('home-body').innerHTML=h;
    $('home-start').onclick=startWizard;
    $('home-refresh').onclick=refresh;
    $('home-sync').onclick=syncStore;
    $('home-monitor').onclick=function(){ openMonitor(S.currentBatch||''); };
    var ip=$('kpi-inprogress');
    if(ip && inProg>0){ ip.onclick=function(){ ajax('getActiveBatch',{},function(e,d){ openMonitor((d&&d.batch)||''); }); }; }
  }
  // `sub` arriva con entità HTML già pronte, quindi non va escapato; `label` sì,
  // per coerenza con `val` — così un domani un'etichetta dinamica resta sicura.
  // filterKey (v1.6.5) rende il KPI un controllo di filtro nel Monitor. E'
  // opzionale: la Dashboard continua a chiamare kpi() con 4 argomenti e ottiene
  // la stessa scheda statica di prima.
  // Un KPI a zero non e' cliccabile — filtrerebbe su una lista vuota.
  function kpi(label,val,sub,cls,filterKey){
    var n=parseInt(val,10);
    var clickable = !!filterKey && !isNaN(n) && n>0;
    var active = !!filterKey && S.monFilter===filterKey;
    var attrs='';
    if(clickable){
      attrs=' data-kpi="'+esc(filterKey)+'" role="button" tabindex="0"'
          + ' aria-pressed="'+(active?'true':'false')+'"'
          + ' title="'+(active?'Clear this filter':'Show only '+esc(label.toLowerCase()))+'"';
    }
    return '<div class="kpi '+cls+(clickable?' clickable':'')+(active?' kpi-active':'')+'"'+attrs+'>'
      + '<div class="kpi-label">'+esc(label)+'</div>'
      + '<div class="kpi-value">'+esc(val)+'</div><div class="kpi-sub">'+(sub||'')+'</div></div>';
  }

  function refresh(){ S.loadedHome=true; loadHome(); }

  // ---- STORE SYNC ----
  // Il server avvia la sync con uno Scheduled Job "Run Once" (non con un evento:
  // la coda eventi su queste istanze accumula ore di ritardo). Qui seguiamo
  // l'avanzamento leggendo sn_appclient.apps_sync_progress, che la piattaforma
  // esprime in PERCENTUALE 0-100 e riporta a 0 quando ha finito.
  //
  // Il tempo che lo scheduler impiega a raccogliere il trigger Run Once NON è
  // sotto il nostro controllo e non è sempre lo stesso: misurato tipicamente
  // sotto i 30s, ma osservato anche nell'ordine di alcuni minuti su istanze
  // sotto carico. Il messaggio di attesa mostra i secondi trascorsi (e un
  // avviso esplicito oltre i 90s) proprio per questo: senza un numero visibile,
  // un'attesa più lunga del solito è indistinguibile da un blocco reale.
  // La sync stessa dura poi ~2 minuti su 1.200 app. Oltre i 5 minuti totali
  // smettiamo di seguirla ma NON la dichiariamo fallita: sta ancora girando
  // sul server.
  function syncStore(){
    var btn=$('home-sync');
    if(!btn || S.syncing){ return; }
    var prev=(S.info&&S.info.lastStoreSync)||'';
    S.syncing=true; btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='Syncing…';
    renderSync(0,'Starting the sync job…');

    ajax('syncStore',{},function(e,d){
      if(e){ finishSync('Store sync could not be started: '+esc(e)); return; }
      if(d && d.error){ finishSync(esc(d.error)); return; }
      if(d && d.alreadyRunning){ renderSync(0,'A sync is already running — following it…'); }

      var startedAt=(d&&d.startedAt)||'';
      var t0=new Date().getTime();
      var GIVE_UP_MS=300000;          // 5 minuti di osservazione
      var sawRunning=false;

      function poll(){
        if(!S.syncing){ return; }
        var elapsed=new Date().getTime()-t0;
        ajax('getSyncProgress',{},function(e2,p){
          if(!S.syncing){ return; }
          if(e2 || !p){
            if(GIVE_UP_MS > elapsed){ setTimeout(poll, 5000); } else { keepGoingInBackground(); }
            return;
          }

          if(p.running){
            sawRunning=true;
            renderSync(p.pct, 'Updating the application catalog…');
            if(GIVE_UP_MS > elapsed){ setTimeout(poll, 3000); } else { keepGoingInBackground(); }
            return;
          }

          // pct 0: idle oppure finita. È finita se il timestamp è avanzato.
          var moved = !!(p.lastSync && (p.lastSync!==prev || (startedAt && p.lastSync>=startedAt)));
          if(moved){
            renderSync(100,'Finished');
            S.syncing=false;
            var b=$('home-sync'); if(b){ b.disabled=false; b.textContent='Sync with Store'; }
            setTimeout(function(){ refresh(); }, 700);
            return;
          }

          // Non ancora partita (il job attende lo scheduler) o già conclusa senza
          // toccare il timestamp: continuo a osservare. Il tempo trascorso è
          // mostrato esplicitamente — senza, un'attesa scheduler più lunga del
          // solito (osservato: pochi minuti, non i ~30s tipici) sembra un blocco.
          if(GIVE_UP_MS > elapsed){
            var waitedS=Math.round(elapsed/1000);
            var waitMsg=sawRunning
              ? 'Finishing…'
              : (waitedS>90
                  ? 'Still waiting for the scheduler to pick up the sync job ('+waitedS+'s — this is taking longer than usual)…'
                  : 'Waiting for the sync job to start… ('+waitedS+'s)');
            renderSync(p.pct, waitMsg);
            setTimeout(poll, sawRunning?3000:6000);
          } else {
            keepGoingInBackground();
          }
        });
      }
      setTimeout(poll, 3000);
    });
  }

  function keepGoingInBackground(){
    S.syncing=false;
    var btn=$('home-sync'); if(btn){ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='Sync with Store'; }
    var box=$('sync-status'); if(!box){ return; }
    box.innerHTML='<div class="sync-row"><span class="sync-dot"></span><span class="sync-msg">'
      + '<strong>Still running after 5 minutes.</strong> The sync continues on the server — '
      + 'it does not need this page. Reopen the app later, or use <strong>Refresh Data</strong> to pick up the updated list.'

  // ---- Paginazione condivisa (v1.6.5) — Step 1, Step 2, Monitor ----
  // Una sola implementazione per le tre viste: page e pageSize sono indicizzati
  // per chiave di vista, cosi' ogni step ricorda la sua posizione senza che le
  // viste si influenzino a vicenda.
  function pageSizeOf(view){ return S.pageSize[view] || 25; }
  function pageCount(total, view){ var ps=pageSizeOf(view); return (total>0) ? Math.ceil(total/ps) : 1; }

  // Il clamp e' il cuore della robustezza: le liste cambiano sotto i piedi
  // dell'utente (filtro digitato, refresh del polling nel Monitor che chiude
  // righe). Senza clamp l'utente resterebbe su una pagina 7 che non esiste piu'
  // e vedrebbe una tabella vuota senza capire perche'.
  function clampPage(total, view){
    var last=pageCount(total, view);
    var cur=S.page[view] || 1;
    if(cur<1) cur=1;
    if(cur>last) cur=last;
    S.page[view]=cur;
    return cur;
  }
  function paginate(list, view){
    var total=list.length, ps=pageSizeOf(view), cur=clampPage(total, view);
    var from=(cur-1)*ps;
    return { rows:list.slice(from, from+ps), total:total, page:cur,
             pages:pageCount(total, view), from:total?(from+1):0,
             to:Math.min(from+ps, total) };
  }
  // Ogni cambio che riordina o riduce la lista riporta a pagina 1: restare a
  // pagina 5 dopo aver digitato un filtro mostrerebbe il nulla.
  function resetPage(view){ S.page[view]=1; }

  // Numeri di pagina con ellissi: prima, ultima, e una finestra intorno alla
  // corrente. Con 200 pagine una lista completa sarebbe illeggibile.
  function pageNumbers(cur, last){
    var out=[], i;
    if(last<=7){ for(i=1;i<=last;i++){ out.push(i); } return out; }
    out.push(1);
    var from=Math.max(2, cur-1), to=Math.min(last-1, cur+1);
    if(cur<=3){ from=2; to=4; }
    if(cur>=last-2){ from=last-3; to=last-1; }
    if(from>2){ out.push('gap-l'); }
    for(i=from;i<=to;i++){ out.push(i); }
    if(to<last-1){ out.push('gap-r'); }
    out.push(last);
    return out;
  }
  // Il pager e' reso come HTML puro e agganciato per event delegation dal
  // chiamante (wirePager): coerente col resto dell'app, che non usa handler
  // inline ne' un handler per elemento.
  function pagerHtml(view, pg){
    if(!pg.total){ return ''; }
    var sizes='', i, ps=pageSizeOf(view);
    for(i=0;i<S.PAGE_SIZES.length;i++){
      var v=S.PAGE_SIZES[i];
      sizes+='<option value="'+v+'"'+(v===ps?' selected':'')+'>'+v+'</option>';
    }
    var nav='';
    nav+='<button class="npu-pg" data-pg="prev" '+(pg.page<=1?'disabled':'')+' aria-label="Previous page">‹</button>';
    var nums=pageNumbers(pg.page, pg.pages);
    for(i=0;i<nums.length;i++){
      var n=nums[i];
      if(n==='gap-l'||n==='gap-r'){ nav+='<span class="npu-pg-gap">…</span>'; continue; }
      var cur=(n===pg.page);
      nav+='<button class="npu-pg'+(cur?' current':'')+'" data-pg="'+n+'"'
         + (cur?' aria-current="page" disabled':'')+' aria-label="Page '+n+'">'+n+'</button>';
    }
    nav+='<button class="npu-pg" data-pg="next" '+(pg.page>=pg.pages?'disabled':'')+' aria-label="Next page">›</button>';
    return '<div class="npu-pager">'
      + '<div class="npu-pager-size"><label for="npu-size-'+view+'">Rows per page</label>'
      +   '<select id="npu-size-'+view+'" data-pgsize="'+view+'">'+sizes+'</select></div>'
      + '<div class="npu-pager-info">Showing '+pg.from+'–'+pg.to+' of '+pg.total+'</div>'
      + '<div class="npu-pager-nav">'+nav+'</div></div>';
  }
  // Un solo handler per pager. rerender e' la funzione di disegno della vista.
  function wirePager(containerId, view, rerender){
    var root=$(containerId); if(!root) return;
    var pager=root.querySelector('.npu-pager'); if(!pager) return;
    var sizeSel=pager.querySelector('select[data-pgsize]');
    if(sizeSel){
      sizeSel.onchange=function(){
        S.pageSize[view]=parseInt(this.value,10)||25;
        resetPage(view);   // cambiare la dimensione rimescola i confini di pagina
        rerender();

    }
    pager.onclick=function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('.npu-pg'):null;
      if(!b || b.disabled) return;
      var v=b.getAttribute('data-pg');
      if(v==='prev'){ S.page[view]=(S.page[view]||1)-1; }
      else if(v==='next'){ S.page[view]=(S.page[view]||1)+1; }
      else { S.page[view]=parseInt(v,10)||1; }
      rerender();
    };
  }

  // ---- Dependency impact (v1.5.4, §6) — two branches, same certainty. See
  // PluginUpdaterAjax.getUpdateImpact: suite branch (sys_suite_config) and
  // dependency branch (DependencyProcessor-style, sys_app_version target
  // recursion) both carry an explicit version constraint against the target.
  //
  // Shared summary badge stays SUITE-ONLY (atomic block, one target per
  // instance — a single top-of-page badge reads unambiguously). But every
  // row that is ITSELF a suite member ALSO gets its own "N more" expansion
  // (v1.5.4) — mirroring the native App Manager, where clicking Update on
  // ANY suite member opens the same suite dialog listing its siblings. A row
  // with no dependency-branch impact but suite membership (e.g. "ServiceNow
  // Otto AI Agents") would otherwise show no expansion at all, even though
  // the native dialog for that exact app lists 8 siblings.
  function impactData(){ return (S.appData&&S.appData.impact)||null; }

  function impactRowsHtml(apps){

  // Per-row impact breakdown (v1.5.4): how many apps does THIS row pull in,
  // and which ones — two sources, merged:
  //  - dependency branch: imp.dependenciesByRoot[scope] (§6.2, per-root BFS)
  //  - suite membership: if this row is ITSELF a suite member, its own
  //    impact is "the rest of the suite" (imp.suite.apps minus this row) —
  //    this mirrors the native App Manager, where clicking Update on ANY
  //    suite member opens the same suite dialog. Without this, a row that
  //    is suite-only (like "ServiceNow Otto AI Agents") showed no expansion
  //    at all, even though the native dialog for that exact app lists its
  //    8 suite siblings (v1.5.4 fix).
  function rowImpactList(scope){
    var imp=impactData();
    var list=((imp&&imp.dependenciesByRoot&&imp.dependenciesByRoot[scope])||[]).slice();
    var suiteApps=(imp&&imp.suite&&imp.suite.apps)||[];
    // Only add suite siblings when THIS row is itself a suite member —
    // otherwise every non-suite row (e.g. Theme Builder) wrongly inherited
    // the entire suite list (v1.5.4 bug, caught in smoke test before ship).
    var isMember=false;
    for(var j=0;j<suiteApps.length;j++){ if(suiteApps[j].scope===scope){ isMember=true; break; } }
    if(isMember){
      for(var i=0;i<suiteApps.length;i++){
        if(suiteApps[i].scope!==scope){ list.push(suiteApps[i]); }
      }
    }
    return list;
  }
  function rowDepCount(scope){ return rowImpactList(scope).length; }
  function rowDepTreeHtml(scope){
    return '<div class="tree-box">'+impactRowsHtml(rowImpactList(scope))+'</div>';
  }

  // ---- WIZARD 2 (Select) ----
  function inFlightSet(){
    var s={}; var f=S.appData.inFlight||[];
    for(var i=0;i<f.length;i++){ s[f[i].sys_id||f[i].sysId]=true; } return s;

  function filteredApps(){

      return !txt || (a.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(txt)>-1 || (a.scope||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(txt)>-1;
    });
  }
  // Gli aggiornamenti arrivano tipicamente a famiglie (sn_csm_*, sn_itom_*):
  // un filtro per scope è più rapido che digitare il prefisso.
  function buildScopeFilter(){
    var sel=$('sel-scope'); if(!sel) return;
    var keep=sel.value||'';
    var apps=S.appData.apps||[], seen={}, list=[];
    for(var i=0;i<apps.length;i++){ var s=apps[i].scope||''; if(s&&!seen[s]){ seen[s]=1; list.push(s); } }
    list.sort();
    var html='<option value="">All scopes ('+apps.length+')</option>';
    for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++){ html+='<option value="'+esc(list[j])+'">'+esc(list[j])+'</option>'; }

  function renderSelect(){

          + '</td><td class="col-scope">'+esc(a.scope)+'</td>'

    var h=renderSuitePanel('sel-suite')
      + '<div class="card"><div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="width:36px"><input class="check" type="checkbox" id="sel-allcheck" aria-label="Select all matching applications" /></th>'
      + wth('name','Application')+wth('scope','Scope')+wth('current','Current → Latest')+wth('status','Status')
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>'+rows+'</tbody></table></div>'
      + pagerHtml('sel', pg)+'</div>';

    // Event delegation: un solo handler sul tbody invece di uno per checkbox.
    // Prima ogni spunta ricostruiva l'intera tabella e riagganciava N handler —

    var tb=$('sel-table').querySelector('tbody');

      // "Select all" agisce su tutte le righe che passano il filtro, non solo su

      // non di selezione (v1.6.5 — invariato rispetto al vecchio cap).
      ac.onchange=function(){

  function toggleApp(id){ if(S.selected[id]){ delete S.selected[id]; } else { S.selected[id]=true; } updateSelCount(); }
  function selectedIds(){ var o=[]; for(var k in S.selected){ if(S.selected[k]) o.push(k); } return o; }
  function updateSelCount(){

  // ---- WIZARD 3: LAUNCH (client fires triggers; server monitors unattended) ----
  // Conferma esplicita: l'installazione è lunga e non annullabile una volta
  // avviata, quindi l'utente deve vedere cosa sta lanciando prima di partire.
  // Impatto per la selezione corrente (§6): suite branch + dependency branch
  // uniti e deduplicati per scope, stesso badge "will be updated" per
  // entrambi — nessuna distinzione euristica, coerente col dialog nativo. Il
  // conteggio è mostrato subito col dialog "count + show all" (§18.1.2): su
  // un'istanza con suite ampie una lista sempre visibile appesantirebbe il
  // dialog anche per selezioni piccole.
  function confirmUnionHtml(union, cb){
    var selIds={}; selectedIds().forEach(function(id){ selIds[id]=true; });
    var scopes=selectedIds().map(function(id){ var a=(S.appData.apps||[]).filter(function(x){return x.sysId===id;})[0]; return a?a.scope:''; }).filter(Boolean);
    ajax('getUpdateImpact', { scopes: scopes.join(',') }, function(err, res){
      if(err || !res){ cb(''); return; }
      var selectedScopeSet={}; (S.appData.apps||[]).forEach(function(a){ if(selIds[a.sysId]){ selectedScopeSet[a.scope]=true; } });
      // Unione suite + dependency branch, deduplicata per scope; "N more"
      // esclude le app già selezionate direttamente dal wizard.
      var merged={}, order=[];
      (res.suite&&res.suite.apps||[]).concat(res.dependencies||[]).forEach(function(a){
        if(selectedScopeSet[a.scope] || merged[a.scope]){ return; }
        merged[a.scope]=a; order.push(a);
      });

  function cicdUrl(row){
    return '/api/sn_cicd/app_repo/install?sys_id='+encodeURIComponent(row.sysId)+'&version='+encodeURIComponent(row.latest);
  }
  function headers(){
    return { 'X-UserToken': (window.g_ck||''), 'Accept':'application/json', 'Content-Type':'application/json' };
  }

  // CICD app_repo install is single-flight (a "CICD Operation" mutex): concurrent
  // enqueues return "Error enqueueing app_install". We enqueue sequentially and
  // retry transient enqueue/mutex collisions with backoff. Offering-required (400)
  // is retried once with the parsed offering id.
  function triggerOne(a, logSysId, done){ fire(a, logSysId, done, 0, false, null); }
  function fire(a, logSysId, done, attempt, withOffering, offeringId){
    var opts={ method:'POST', credentials:'same-origin', headers:headers() };
    if(withOffering && offeringId){ opts.body=JSON.stringify({ offering:offeringId }); }
    fetch(cicdUrl(a), opts)
      .then(function(resp){ return resp.json().then(function(b){ return {status:resp.status, body:b}; }); })
      .then(function(r){ handleTrigger(a, logSysId, r, done, attempt, withOffering); })
      .catch(function(err){ retryOrFail(a, logSysId, done, attempt, 'Fetch error: '+err.message); });
  }
  function trigErr(r){ return (r.body&&r.body.result&&r.body.result.error) || (r.body&&r.body.error&&(r.body.error.message||r.body.error.detail)) || ('HTTP '+r.status); }
  function isTransient(status, msg){
    if(status===409||status===429||status===503) return true;
    var m=(''+msg).toLowerCase();
    return m.indexOf('enqueue')>-1 || m.indexOf('mutex')>-1 || m.indexOf('in progress')>-1 || m.indexOf('try again')>-1 || m.indexOf('another')>-1;
  }
  function handleTrigger(a, logSysId, r, done, attempt, withOffering){
    if(r.status===200||r.status===201){
      var pid=r.body&&r.body.result&&r.body.result.links&&r.body.result.links.progress&&r.body.result.links.progress.id;
      if(pid){ ajax('attachWorker',{ log_sys_id:logSysId, progress_id:pid }, function(){ done(); }); return; }
      failTrigger(a, logSysId,'The install was accepted but no progress ID was returned, so it cannot be tracked.', done); return;
    }
    var msg=trigErr(r);
    if(r.status===400 && !withOffering){
      var m1=(''+msg).match(/\[([^\]]+)\]/), m2=(''+msg).match(/"offering"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
      var offering=(m1&&m1[1])||(m2&&m2[1])||null;
      if(offering && (''+msg).toLowerCase().indexOf('offering')>-1){ fire(a, logSysId, done, attempt, true, offering); return; }
    }
    if(isTransient(r.status, msg)){ retryOrFail(a, logSysId, done, attempt, msg); return; }
    failTrigger(a, logSysId, 'HTTP ' + r.status + ' — ' + msg, done);
  }
  function retryOrFail(a, logSysId, done, attempt, msg){
    var MAX=8;
    if(attempt<MAX){
      renderLaunch('Waiting for the CICD queue… (retry '+(attempt+1)+'/'+MAX+')');
      setTimeout(function(){ fire(a, logSysId, done, attempt+1, false, null); }, 2000 + attempt*800);
    } else {
      failTrigger(a, logSysId, 'Still rejected after '+MAX+' retries — ' + msg, done);
    }
  }
  // Registra il motivo del mancato avvio, oltre a marcare la riga sul server:
  // senza questo l'utente vedeva solo "N failed to launch" senza il perché.
  function failTrigger(a, logSysId, message, done){
    S.launchFailed++;
    if(!S.launchErrors){ S.launchErrors=[]; }
    S.launchErrors.push({
      key:   logSysId || ('e'+S.launchErrors.length),
      name:  (a && a.name) || '(unknown application)',
      scope: (a && a.scope) || '',
      target:(a && a.latest) || '',

    ajax('failRow',{ log_sys_id:logSysId, message:message }, function(){ done(); });
  }

      + kpi('Total', c.total||0, S.monFilter?'in this batch • clear filter':'in this batch','','__all__')
      + kpi('Installing', c.installing||0, 'running now', (c.installing>0)?'accent':'', 'installing')
      + kpi('Queued', c.queued||0, 'waiting in queue','', 'queued')
      + kpi('Complete', c.complete||0, 'installed','success', 'complete')
      + kpi('Failed', c.failed||0, 'see message', (c.failed>0)?'warning':'', 'failed')
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="actions-bar"><div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2)">Batch status: '+statusPill(bs)
      +   (S.monFilter?' · filtered by <strong>'+esc(S.monFilter)+'</strong> <button class="link-btn" id="mon-showall-rows">show all</button>':'')+'</div>'
      +   '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3)">Last refreshed '+esc(new Date().toLocaleString())+'</div></div>'
      + '<div class="card"><div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr>'
      + th('name','Application')+th('scope','Scope')+th('latest','Version')+th('status','Status')+th('pct','Progress',' style="min-width:160px"')
      + '<th style="width:110px">Details</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>'+rows+'</tbody></table></div>'
      + pagerHtml('mon', pg)+'</div>';
    $('mon-body').innerHTML=h;

    // Espansione/chiusura del dettaglio: lo stato vive in S.whyOpen, quindi
    // sopravvive ai refresh del polling e all'ordinamento.
    var wb=$('mon-body').querySelectorAll('.why-btn');
    for(var w=0;w<wb.length;w++){
      wb[w].onclick=function(){
        var k=this.getAttribute('data-why');
        if(S.whyOpen[k]){ delete S.whyOpen[k]; } else { S.whyOpen[k]=true; }
        renderMonitor(S.monData);
      };
    }

    // Filtro per status. Un solo punto di verita' (S.monFilter): "Show only
    // failures" del riquadro conclusivo e il KPI Failed sono lo stesso stato,
    // cosi' il KPI si illumina anche quando il filtro parte dal riquadro.
    function setMonFilter(k){
      if(k==='__all__' || S.monFilter===k){ S.monFilter=''; }   // Total = reset, ri-click = toggle-off
      else { S.monFilter=k; }
      resetPage('mon');            // il filtro cambia la lista: si riparte da pagina 1
      renderMonitor(S.monData);
    }
    var of=$('mon-onlyfailed'); if(of){ of.onclick=function(){ S.monFilter='failed'; resetPage('mon'); renderMonitor(S.monData); }; }
    var sr=$('mon-showall-rows'); if(sr){ sr.onclick=function(){ setMonFilter('__all__'); }; }

    // Un solo handler per l'intera griglia KPI (event delegation), come il
    // resto dell'app. I KPI a zero non portano data-kpi e restano inerti.
    var kg=$('mon-body').querySelector('.kpi-grid');
    if(kg){
      kg.onclick=function(e){
        var card=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('[data-kpi]'):null;
        if(card){ setMonFilter(card.getAttribute('data-kpi')); }
      };
      // Stessa azione da tastiera: le schede sono role="button".
      kg.onkeydown=function(e){
        if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '||e.keyCode===13||e.keyCode===32){
          var card=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('[data-kpi]'):null;
          if(card){ e.preventDefault(); setMonFilter(card.getAttribute('data-kpi')); }
        }
      };
    }
    wirePager('mon-body', 'mon', function(){ renderMonitor(S.monData); });

    // "Cancel queued" solo quando c'è effettivamente qualcosa da annullare.
    var cb=$('mon-cancel');
    if(cb){ cb.style.display=((c.queued||0)>0)?'inline-flex':'none'; }

    // Annuncio per screen reader: il polling cambia il DOM senza che l'utente
    // non vedente se ne accorga.
    if(bs!=='running'){ announce('Batch '+bs+': '+(c.complete||0)+' complete, '+(c.failed||0)+' failed'); }
    else { announce((c.installing||0)+' installing, '+(c.queued||0)+' queued, '+(c.complete||0)+' complete'); }

    var ths=$('mon-body').querySelectorAll('th.sortable');
    function applyMon(th2){
      var k=th2.getAttribute('data-k');
      if(S.monSort && S.monSort.k===k){ S.monSort.dir=(S.monSort.dir===1?-1:1); }
      else { S.monSort={k:k,dir:1}; }
      resetPage('mon');
      renderMonitor(S.monData);
    }
    for(var j=0;j<ths.length;j++){
      ths[j].onclick=function(){ applyMon(this); };
      ths[j].onkeydown=function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '||e.keyCode===13||e.keyCode===32){ e.preventDefault(); applyMon(this); } };
    }
  }

  // ---- Wiring ----
  function init(){
    // v1.6: refresh automatico anche quando si torna dal Monitor — senza
    // questo la Home restava con i contatori pre-batch (es. "Updates
    // Available" non ancora decrementato) finché non si cliccava Refresh
    // Data a mano. monitorActive() va controllato PRIMA di showView('home'),
    // che disattiva la vista monitor cambiando la classe .active.
    $('tab-home').onclick=function(){
      var fromMonitor=monitorActive();
      showView('home');
      if(!S.loadedHome || fromMonitor){ refresh(); }
    };
    $('tab-wizard').onclick=startWizard;
    $('tab-monitor').onclick=function(){ openMonitor(S.currentBatch||''); };
    $('tab-guide').onclick=function(){ showView('guide'); };
    var gf=$('guide-foot'); if(gf){ gf.textContent='Now Plugin Updater v'+S.version+' · by Gianmario Marongiu'; }
    $('btn-refresh').onclick=refresh;
    // Debounce: senza, ogni carattere digitato ricostruisce l'intera tabella.
    $('sel-filter').oninput=debounce(function(){ resetPage('sel'); renderSelect(); }, 150);
    $('sel-scope').onchange=function(){ resetPage('sel'); renderSelect(); };
    $('sel-all').onclick=function(){ var l=filteredApps(), iff=inFlightSet(); for(var i=0;i<l.length;i++){ if(!iff[l[i].sysId]) S.selected[l[i].sysId]=true; } renderSelect(); };
    $('sel-none').onclick=function(){ S.selected={}; renderSelect(); };
    $('sel-install').onclick=confirmInstalls;
    $('sel-back').onclick=function(){ showView('wizard1'); };
    $('sel-cancel').onclick=function(){ showView('home'); };
    // w1-next / w1-cancel sono resi dentro renderWizard1(): agganciati là.
    $('launch-monitor').onclick=function(){ openMonitor(S.currentBatch||''); };
    $('launch-home').onclick=function(){ showView('home'); refresh(); };
    $('mon-batch').onchange=function(){ S.currentBatch=this.value; S.monFilter=''; resetPage('mon'); startMonitorPolling(); };
    $('mon-refresh').onclick=function(){ startMonitorPolling(); };
    $('mon-cancel').onclick=cancelQueued;
    refresh();
  }

  if(document.readyState==='loading'){ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); }
  else { init(); }
})();
